svg.title: OpenAMRobot networking and DDS topology with three configuration traps
svg.desc: Operator PC with RViz on Wi-Fi talks over ROS 2 DDS discovery to a Raspberry Pi 5 robot, reached by mDNS botshare.local. A Teensy 4.0 connects to the Pi over USB via the micro-ROS agent. Every ROS 2 node must export RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_cyclonedds_cpp and ROS_DOMAIN_ID=0. Three red traps: PC defaulting to FastDDS or domain 42, a Docker UI using FastDDS, and a Wi-Fi Guest network breaking mDNS and DDS discovery.

g.text: Networking / DDS topology — Operator PC ⇄ OpenAMRobot (Wi-Fi)
ROS 2 DDS discovery (UDP multicast) over Wi-Fi
reach the robot by mDNS name botshare.local — not a hard-coded DHCP IP
Every ROS 2 node (PC, robot, and any Docker UI) must export the same RMW + domain:
PC left at default RMW (FastDDS) or
Container UI defaults to FastDDS and the
RMW / DOMAIN_ID env is not passed into
the container — it mismatches the robot.
fix: pass RMW + DOMAIN into container
Guest SSID isolates clients and blocks
fix: use main WLAN, allow mDNS/multicast
